title: Manipur: NPCM calls sit-in protest in Imphal over killing of four Naga civilians in Ukhrul

ai.summary: The Native People’s Committee Manipur (NPCM) called a sit-in protest at Imphal's ISBT to address the killing of four civilians in Ukhrul district, demanding accountability and justice for the victims allegedly killed by Kuki militants.

facts.claim: NPCM called a sit-in protest at the Inter-State Bus Terminus (ISBT) in Khuman Lampak, Imphal, on Wednesday, November 18
facts.quote: Imphal: The Native People’s Committee Manipur (NPCM) has called a sit-in protest at the Inter-State Bus Terminus (ISBT) in Khuman Lampak, Imphal, on Wednesday, November 18, to decide its next course of agitation over the killing of four civilians in Ukhrul district’s New Heaven area.

facts.claim: The killing of four civilians in Ukhrul district’s New Heaven area
facts.quote: Four civilians, including a woman and members of the Tangkhul Naga community, were reportedly killed in an armed ambush along National Highway 202 near New Heaven in Ukhrul district while travelling from Ukhrul to Imphal.

facts.claim: The victims were allegedly killed by Kuki militants
facts.quote: The leaders said the gathering would deliberate on further protest action, demand accountability and seek justice for the victims, who were allegedly killed by Kuki militants.

ai.background_note: The NPCM has called multiple protests following killings in Manipur, including a 48-hour statewide shutdown after three Meitei firewood collectors were killed.
